evals.prompt: 这是经过核实的新闻正文，请直接为 Level Read 做三档内容和一张 5:3 无文字封面，生成音频和未发布 CMS 包，但不要入库。来源是 https://example.com/story，日期是 2026-08-23。
evals.expected_output: The skill uses Codex for level content and cover, invokes publisher.py produce, archives every local artifact including cover.png under ~/Documents/Level Read Production/YYYY-MM-DD-titleid/, and does not ingest.

evals.prompt: 请把已完成的 Level Read 生产包添加到 CMS 的未发布列表。
evals.expected_output: The skill validates the package, requires an explicit ingest request, runs publisher.py ingest with the confirmation flag, and reports the record id.

evals.prompt: 检查这台电脑是否已配置好 Level Read 新闻生产能力。不要生成、上传或入库。
evals.expected_output: The skill runs the read-only doctor command, reports only missing configuration keys, and never displays secret values.

evals.prompt: 帮我做一篇 Level Read 新闻：标题是‘某国宣布新的海上保护区’，摘要只有‘政府说这会保护海洋生物’。我没有原文链接。先补全并核实新闻事实，再生成完整生产包；不要入库。
evals.expected_output: The skill researches reliable sources before drafting, distinguishes confirmed facts from attribution and uncertainty, reports the source links used, and does not invent missing details.
